name: ETCS Signalling Message Latency
description: End-to-end latency of ETCS movement authority messages. Checks whether safety timing requirements are met.

elements.name: MA Message End-to-End Latency
elements.description: Latency from RBC computation to on-board acknowledgement. Uncertain due to GSM-R network load.

uncertainty.source: GSM-R network measurement under peak load

elements.name: Maximum Allowable MA Latency
elements.description: ETCS Subset-026 maximum permitted message latency

consistency_relations.upr_description: The ETCS Subset-026 latency limit guards the message delivery uncertainty set; latencies above 500 ms trigger protective braking.
